admission.justification: Saved-input replay prevents current source edits or unknown outcomes becoming another first assignment or agent.

applicability: Start/retry with the request ID already at the selection receipt address.
conditions: Request digest and starter ownership still match.
exclusions: Resolved executions may refresh host status under R07 without recompiling.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_paseo_launch_repeat.py::RepeatAfterChangeTests::test_a_repeat_is_answered_from_its_receipt_whatever_changed_since_the_launch; mcp/tests/test_orca_handover_binding.py::RepeatAfterDocumentEditTests::test_a_repeat_runs_the_stored_call_after_the_leaf_document_was_edited; RepeatAndConflictTests::test_a_repeated_request_converges_on_the_same_agent; l4-review/evidence/j1-… to j8-…, k5-…; l4-verify/evidence/a1-… to a11-…, a7a to a7h; l4-verify3/evidence/a1-* to a8-*

statement: A request whose receipt at its address carries its request id is answered from that receipt and is not compiled again: a `starting` or `unknown` receipt runs its stored call under the minted agent id and with the first message as saved, any other status returns the saved execution; a task document, the capsule or the first message that changed since the launch cannot turn the repeat into a conflict.
